title: Urban Sketch — Morning Commute
description: Capture the rhythm of the city during morning rush hour.
rules: Draw or paint on-location references or your own photos only. One submission per user.

title: Monochrome Mood
description: Create a piece using only one color family and its values.
rules: Single hue with tints/shades only. No multi-color blending.

title: Found Objects
description: Assemble an artwork from objects found around you.
rules: Man-made and from nature both acceptable

title: Night Lights
description: Explore artificial light sources after dark.
rules: Low-light references encouraged. Share camera settings if photo.

title: Hands at Work
description: Depict hands creating or building something.
rules: Focus on gesture and process details; avoid generic poses.

title: Reflections
description: Create an artwork that uses reflections (glass, water, metal).
rules: Reflections must be central to composition.

title: Negative Space
description: Design a composition driven by negative space.
rules: At least 40% of the area should be negative space.

title: Texture Study
description: Showcase contrasting textures within one piece.
rules: Use at least two clearly different textures.

title: Motion Blur
rules: Use lines, blur, or repeated forms to suggest movement.

title: Tiny Worlds
description: Imagine a miniature environment with its own rules.
rules: Include at least three distinct micro-elements.

title: Rainy Day
description: Celebrate rain—drops, puddles, skies, or mood.
rules: Water/rain elements must be clearly visible.

title: Silhouettes
description: Tell a story using silhouettes and strong shapes.
rules: Limit details inside silhouettes; emphasize contours.

title: From Above
description: Use a top-down or aerial viewpoint.
rules: Perspective must be clearly from above.

title: Daily Ritual
description: Document a small ritual from everyday life.
rules: Add a 1–2 sentence caption describing the ritual.

title: Contrast of Scale
description: Place very large and very small elements together.
rules: Include at least one exaggerated size contrast.
